title: Scions of the Divine 0.1
author: Dark Seraph Productions
font_credit: MiSans (c) 2020-2021 Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
_why_script_override: The game ships every script inside game/archive.rpa and has no Ren'Py translation templates -- game/tl/ holds only None/common.rpym, the file Ren'Py itself writes. There is nothing for build_tl.py to compile, and tools/install.py cannot replace a game's own scripts. The patch drops 28 Chinese .rpy files next to the archive; Ren'Py prefers a loose file over the same path inside an archive, so the archive itself is never rewritten. See docs/approach.md.
_why_ps1: tools/install.py only knows how to place a translation tree, a shim and fonts. It cannot override the game's scripts, so this game ships its own installer next to the patch.
_coverage_note: 5,094 player-visible strings, counted during extraction from the English scripts (every say statement, text/textbutton/label/caption/title argument, menu choice, Character name and UI string in the 27 replaced scripts). All but 36 are translated; the 36 are the 12 distinct labels of the developer menu in screen_dev.rpy, deliberately listed in docs/glossary.json under _kept_verbatim. Counted from the English original, not from data/tl_trans.json -- that file is reverse-derived from the finished Chinese .rpy and is not a build input, so it cannot report coverage.
